name: Thunderhawk Wings
summary: Thunderhawk Wings are feathered trophies taken from the fierce wind serpents soaring above the central and southern Barrens. Presented to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo, they serve as definitive proof of a hunter's strength, cunning, and endurance in tracking down one of the savanna's most majestic predators.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: Wind serpents, known to local hunters as thunderhawks, are formidable winged reptiles capable of striking swiftly from above. For the hunters stationed at Camp Taurajo, harvesting a pair of intact Thunderhawk Wings is far more than collecting biological scraps; it represents the culmination of grueling hunting trials in the Barrens. By tracking the aerial predators across the open plains and claiming their wings in combat, an initiate proves their readiness to walk the lifelong path of an accomplished hunter.

faq.answer: Thunderhawk Wings are harvested from the thunderhawks that glide along the ridges and plains of the central and southern Barrens, particularly in the lands surrounding Camp Taurajo.
Jorn Skyseer, a seasoned tauren hunter stationed at Camp Taurajo, asks for them as proof that an initiate has mastered the hunting rites of the savanna.

faq.q: What does claiming the wings signify?
faq.answer: Bringing the wings back to Jorn Skyseer marks the completion of a challenging rite of passage, confirming that the hunter possesses the strength, courage, and patience needed to confront apex aerial predators.

angles.text: Claiming the wings of a soaring thunderhawk represents a rite of passage, validating your tracking, patience, and marksmanship against swift aerial beasts.
To the hunters of Taurajo, harvesting these wings honors the spirit of the savanna and demonstrates respect for the Earthmother's fierce creatures.
